tier: isp-proxies (dedicated per IP, shared per GB, shared per IP)

free_tier.stated: 3-day free trial with 100 MB included to test performance before committing; 14-day money-back option on paid plans.
free_tier.notes: The ISP page states '100MB included' for the 3-day trial and does not say whether incoming bytes, outgoing bytes or both are counted.

retention.stated: not applicable: a live address, not stored bytes
retention.notes: No stored bytes are involved. The address is static: the page states that ISP proxies 'hold a fixed IP indefinitely' and that static ISP proxies 'maintain a constant IP for the full duration of your session'.

egress.terms: Dedicated ISP is sold per address with no bandwidth figure: the plan list states 'High bandwidth & concurrency support', and each tier is priced '+ VAT billed monthly'. Shared ISP is sold per GB ('From $1.30/GB') or per address ('From $0.27/IP'). The dedicated headline 'From $2/IP' is the price of the 2000-IP tier.
egress.price_per_tb: USD 1.30 per GB on shared ISP, the vendor's own unit; the page publishes no per-TB price

interface_detail: Protocols 'SOCKS5 & HTTP(S)'. Authentication is a username and password against endpoint isp.decodo.com:10000; the page's Python example connects to isp.decodo.com:10001. The price links lead to dashboard.decodo.com/isp/pricing.
tooling: Any client that accepts a SOCKS5 or HTTP(S) proxy with a username and password. The page's code example is Python requests through 'http://{username}:{password}@isp.decodo.com:10001', with tabs for Python, Node.js, cURL, Go and PHP; it states 'Drop-in compatibility with Requests, Playwright, and Puppeteer' and links integration guides for Multilogin, AdsPower, Proxy SwitchyOmega, a Chrome proxy extension and a Firefox proxy add-on.
chaining: The outbound hop of an HTTP client ('Route Python, Node.js, or cURL traffic through the proxy'). A dedicated address gives one fixed source identity across requests ('Dedicated ISP proxies give you a fixed IP that only you can use'); shared ISP is the vendor's option for volume ('Choose shared ISP proxies if your priority is handling large volumes of traffic efficiently across multiple connections').

limits.value: 100 MB over 3 days on the free trial
shared ISP is billed per gigabyte from USD 1.30/GB with no cap published: cost, not a ceiling, is what stops it

dedicated ISP is billed per address: self-serve from USD 3.33/IP at 3 IPs (USD 9.99 + VAT a month) down to USD 2.50/IP at 200 IPs (USD 500 + VAT a month); 500, 700, 1000 and 2000 IPs at USD 2.30, 2.20, 2.10 and 2.00/IP are sold through contact sales

limits_note: The page publishes no request-rate limit, concurrency ceiling or per-address bandwidth cap; its only statement on the subject is 'High bandwidth & concurrency support', with no number. Dedicated ISP is paid by 'Number of dedicated IPs', so each additional fixed identity is one more address at the per-IP rate; no limit kind names a per-identity price. Tiers from 500 IPs (USD 2.3/IP, USD 1150 + VAT a month) route to contact sales instead of a buy link.
binding_note: No limit kind binds: the page states no request rate, concurrency limit or byte cap, and 'High bandwidth & concurrency support' carries no number. Dedicated ISP is priced per address and shared ISP per GB or per address, with 'no minimum commitment on both Pay/IP and Pay/GB plans', so price, not a published limit, bounds use.

identity_cost.detail: Payment for ISP proxies is by card or wallet, not cryptocurrency: 'We accept payments with credit cards, PayPal, Alipay, Google Pay, and Apple Pay. You can also pay with cryptocurrency for all products except ISP proxies and datacenter proxies (Pay per IP option).' Orders are processed by Paddle as Merchant of Record. Account set-up is 'Create your Decodo account, verify your email address'. Whether the 3-day ISP trial needs a payment method is unverified: behind a sign-up; for residential plans the trial converts on its own ('after the trial period ends, your chosen plan will activate automatically').

reliability_note: Of the two addresses the vendor publishes as its own samples, 37.120.211.30 is registered to M247-LTD-Warsaw in AS9009 M247 Europe SRL with the RDAP remark 'M247 LTD Warsaw Infrastructure', a hosting network, so a target that checks registration class sees hosting and not an ISP; the other, 90.135.104.218, is Tele2 Sverige AB (AS1257, LT-TELE2-GPRS, LT) and passes.
confidence_note: Documented: prices, protocols, endpoint and the 3-day trial are on the vendor's ISP product page. The addresses whose registration is looked up are the two samples the page publishes in its hero image, 'isp_01 37.120.211.30 and isp_02 90.135.104.218', not addresses issued to a buyer; no purchased address has been looked up, and whether an address stays the same across reconnects is unmeasured.

evidence.proved: Three ISP plans (dedicated, pay per GB, pay per IP) with the vendor's own headlines 'From $2/IP', 'From $1.30/GB' and 'From $0.27/IP'; the self-serve dedicated ladder at 3.33, 2.90, 2.80, 2.70, 2.60 and 2.50 USD/IP for 3, 10, 20, 50, 100 and 200 IPs; the 500-IP tier routed to #contact-sales; 'Protocols SOCKS5 & HTTP(S)'; endpoint isp.decodo.com:10000 with username and password; '3-day free trial' with '100MB included'; '14-day money-back option'; 'Premium ASNs' naming AT&T, Verizon, Orange and Tele2.

The hero image's alt text is the only machine-readable copy of the two sample addresses: 'Authentication method panel listing isp_01 37.120.211.30 and isp_02 90.135.104.218, Endpoint generator UI and cURL example'. The addresses are pixels in a webp otherwise, which is why they needed an outside registration check.
37.120.211.30 is not announced on its own and aligns to 37.120.211.0/24, announced by AS9009 M247 Europe SRL. A hosting ASN, so sample isp_01 fails the vendor's own ISP claim.

RDAP for 37.120.211.0/24: name M247-LTD-Warsaw, country PL, type ASSIGNED PA, remark 'M247 LTD Warsaw Infrastructure', maintained by M247 entities. Confirms the registration is a hosting operator's Warsaw infrastructure.

90.135.104.218 aligns to 90.135.0.0/16, announced by AS1257 SWIPNET Tele2 Sverige AB. An ISP ASN, so sample isp_02 agrees with the vendor's claim, and the vendor's 'Premium ASNs' line names Tele2 by name.

RDAP for 90.135.0.0/16: name LT-TELE2-GPRS, country LT, type ASSIGNED PA, remark 'Mobile Services Lithuania'. Passes as an ISP registration, with the sub-registration described as mobile services rather than fixed line.
